children: S-BANK TO COMMENCE REDEMPTION PROCEEDINGS IN RESPECT OF REMAINING MINORITY SHARES IN OMA SAVINGS BANK
TO IMPLEMENT REDEMPTION OF REMAINING SHARES, OFFEROR WILL INITIATE ARBITRATION PROCEEDINGS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE
IN SUCH REDEMPTION PROCEEDINGS, OFFEROR WILL DEMAND THAT REDEMPTION PRICE FOR REMAINING SHARES BE SET AT EUR 17.20 PER SHARE
